description: Inspect an address on a chain: whether it is a contract, best-effort ERC-20 token metadata (name, symbol, decimals), and EIP-1967 proxy detection (implementation address). Built from eth_getCode / eth_call / eth_getStorageAt, which are plain JSON-RPC passthrough. The metadata is best-effort and may be absent on a non-standard contract.

chain.description: Chain slug as in rpc.ankr.com/<chain> — any chain Ankr serves (see listChains)

name: resolveContract
title: Identify a contract
